public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        long num = 1;
        final long MOD = 1000000007L;

        if (k <= 1) {
            long limit = (long)p - 1 + k;
            for (long step = 0; step < limit; ++step) {
                num = (num * p) % MOD;
            }
        } else {
            boolean[] used = new boolean[p];
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                if (used[i]) continue;
                num = (num * p) % MOD;
                int cur = i;
                used[cur] = true;
                cur = (int)((long)cur * k % p);
                while (cur != i) {
                    used[cur] = true;
                    cur = (int)((long)cur * k % p);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(num);
    }
}
